description: wtphm is an open-source software project listed in Awesome Sustainable Technology, a curated list of open-source sustainability projects under the section "Wind Turbines", published or maintained by lkev (repository owner; maintainers as on the project page). The Wind Turbine Prognostics and Health Management library processes wind turbine events data, as well as operational SCADA data for easier fault detection, prognostics or reliability research. Coverage: not geographically bound. The list files it under "Wind Turbines" (wind power). The listed link gives the source code or documentation; nothing was downloaded or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated in the list entry (repository not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wind power studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-awesome-sustainable-technology.
